# GreenMedInfo

> > A natural health research platform providing evidence-based information on botanical medicine, nutritional science, and integrative health through subscription-based access to curated research databases.

GreenMedInfo is a comprehensive health research resource founded by Sayer Ji that aggregates peer-reviewed studies on natural remedies, herbs, and nutritional interventions. The platform offers tiered membership plans including the Emerald Membership with access to the Research Dashboard, enabling users to explore connections between foods, supplements, and health conditions.
